parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the std-only Rust 2021 port, root test14.rs, Cargo project, CLI parsing, byte-identical formatting, negative and invalid argument behavior, and reference executable debugging requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent delegated a binary-probing helper but kept ownership of behavior modeling, implementation, integration, build repair, verification, and final delivery.
parallel.implementation: The parent wrote Cargo.toml, lib.rs, cli.rs, model.rs, program.rs, and test14.rs, then patched TryFrom imports so both Cargo and bare rustc builds worked.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent assembled a root-level Cargo package and executable, built /output/test14, and final artifact validation listed the source files, binaries, Cargo.lock, and build outputs.
parallel.verification: Verification included cargo test, cargo build --release, rustc builds, diff comparisons against the reference executable for representative values, and invalid/out-of-range abort checks.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The helper probe never returned and was interrupted after wait timeouts, but the parent independently completed the accepted implementation and no official testcase failed.

serial.requirements: The serial thread recognized the same std-only Rust 2021 port, exact CLI parsing, byte-identical output, Cargo project, root test14.rs, and reference executable behavior obligations.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single actor owned all probing, modeling, implementation, build repair, verification, and final delivery without delegation or shared ownership boundaries.
serial.implementation: The serial run wrote Cargo.toml, test14.rs, and src modules for parsing, vector behavior, and program execution, then patched imports/pathing for both build modes.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial thread assembled the src-based Cargo package, generated /output/test14, and artifact validation listed the source tree, root entry, executable, Cargo.lock, and build outputs.
serial.verification: Verification included reference probes, rustc, cargo build --release, byte diffs for normal and edge cases, abort-behavior checks, and cargo test.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No required stage remained unfinished at closure; official evaluation completed and passed all 40 testcases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The helper received the same overall task context and probed relevant binary behavior, but no child implementation or interface contract was needed for integration.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial held all context locally and translated observations directly into code.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel created a context boundary for probing only; there was no missing interoperation contract or harmful handoff because the parent did not depend on a returned child artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented root-level modules for CLI parsing, model behavior, and program output, then fixed rustc compatibility.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented an src-based Cargo library plus root entry and fixed the same rustc compatibility issue.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Implementation layout differed slightly, but both modeled the same behavior and produced passing artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The helper never returned a final result; the parent waited, interrupted it, and closed after using its own work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results; local observations fed directly into code and checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a stalled child lifecycle, but it was auxiliary and did not affect deliverable acceptance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent wrote the implementation files and built outputs; child only created /output/src late and no competing implementation reached final artifacts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a coherent src tree and executable without any concurrent writer.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a shared workspace but no collision, overwrite, contamination, or provenance problem in the accepted tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran cargo test, cargo build, rustc builds, representative diffs, invalid/overflow checks, and official evaluation passed 40/40.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran rustc, cargo build, byte diffs, abort checks, cargo test, and official evaluation passed 40/40.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Verification breadth was comparable; parallel had more probes and checks, serial had fewer but sufficient checks.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed more agent time and tokens because of child probing and waits, but finished within budget and passed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial finished faster with no delegation and lower token/tool use while also passing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The main practical difference is overhead: parallel took about 320 agent seconds and two subagents, serial about 225 seconds and no subagents.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both current completed status.json evaluations passed 40 of 40 testcases. Parallel differed by spawning a helper that probed behavior but stalled and was interrupted; the parent nevertheless independently implemented, built, verified, and delivered the accepted Rust port. Serial performed the same core work in one thread and delivered an accepted Rust port with less coordination overhead.
parallel_contributors: Parent retained implementation and verification ownership despite spawning a helper.
Auxiliary helper stall added overhead but did not remove any required deliverable or acceptance step.
serial_contributors: Single-threaded execution avoided handoff and wait overhead while preserving the same behavior modeling and build checks.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used root-level library files; serial used src modules. Both layouts met the prompt and official evaluator.
Both encountered standalone rustc TryFrom import issues and patched them before final verification.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; process contrast only
